import { useMemo, useState, type FormEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ArrowUpRight, Bird, CalendarDays, Check, ChevronRight, CircleAlert, Egg, Filter, Leaf, MapPin, MoreHorizontal, Package, Plus, Search, ShieldAlert, Sprout } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLocation } from 'wouter';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  getGetDashboardSummaryQueryKey, getGetFinanceSummaryQueryKey, getGetLivestockSummaryQueryKey, getListAlertsQueryKey, getListFarmZonesQueryKey, getListGoatsQueryKey, getListInventoryQueryKey, getListPoultryFlocksQueryKey, getListTasksQueryKey, getSearchFarmQueryKey,
  useCompleteTask, useCreateGoat, useCreateInventoryItem, useCreateTask, useGetDashboardSummary, useGetFinanceSummary, useGetLivestockSummary, useListAlerts, useListFarmZones, useListGoats, useListInventory, useListPoultryFlocks, useListTasks, useRecordInventoryTransaction, useSearchFarm,
  type Alert, type DashboardSummary, type FarmZone, type FinanceSummary, type Goat, type InventoryItem, type PoultryFlock, type Task,
} from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import { Button, EmptyState, ErrorState, FormField, Loading, Meter, Modal, Panel, PanelTitle, SaveButton, SelectField, Stat, Badge, IconButton } from '@/components/ui-kit';
import { PageHeading } from '@/components/farm-shell';

const money = (n?: number) => `$${(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}`;
const date = (s?: string | null) => s ? new Date(`${s}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }) : '‚Äî';
const toneFor = (value?: string) => value?.toLowerCase().includes('high') || value?.toLowerCase().includes('critical') || value?.toLowerCase().includes('sick') ? 'red' : value?.toLowerCase().includes('preg') || value?.toLowerCase().includes('active') ? 'gold' : 'green';

function SectionLink({ href, children }: { href: string; children: ReactNode }) { const [, setLocation] = useLocation(); return <button data-testid={`button-view-${href.replaceAll('/', '-')}`} onClick={() => setLocation(href)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-[hsl(var(--primary))] hover:underline">{children}<ChevronRight size={14} /></button>; }

function DashboardSkeleton() { return <div className="space-y-5"><div className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-[hsl(var(--muted))]" /><div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">{[1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-[hsl(var(--muted))]" />)}</div><div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3"><div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-[hsl(var(--muted))]" /><div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-[hsl(var(--muted))] lg:col-span-2" /></div></div>; }

export function DashboardPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useGetDashboardSummary({ query: { queryKey: getGetDashboardSummaryQueryKey(), staleTime: 30000 } });
  const [, setLocation] = useLocation();
  const summary = data as DashboardSummary | undefined;
  if (isLoading) return <DashboardSkeleton />;
  if (isError || !summary) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />;
  const done = summary.tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'completed').length;
  const glance: Array<{ label: string; value: number; href: string; Icon: typeof Egg }> = [
    { label: 'Goats', value: summary.livestock.goats, href: '/livestock/goats', Icon: Egg },
    { label: 'Chickens', value: summary.livestock.chickens, href: '/livestock/poultry', Icon: Bird },
    { label: 'Crop cycles', value: summary.activeCropCycles, href: '/farm-map', Icon: Sprout },
    { label: 'Orchard trees', value: summary.orchardTrees, href: '/farm-map', Icon: Leaf },
    { label: 'Low stock', value: summary.lowStockItems, href: '/inventory', Icon: Package },
    { label: 'Pregnant', value: summary.livestock.pregnantGoats, href: '/livestock/goats', Icon: CircleAlert },
  ];
  return <div className="space-y-5 animate-rise">
    <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-[hsl(var(--primary))] px-5 py-6 text-[hsl(var(--primary-foreground))] sm:px-8 sm:py-7">
      <div className="absolute -right-8 -top-16 h-48 w-48 rounded-full border-[24px] border-[hsl(var(--accent)/.26)]" /><div className="absolute bottom-[-76px] right-28 h-40 w-40 rounded-full border-[14px] border-[hsl(var(--accent)/.15)]" />
      <div className="relative flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-end"><div><div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.16em] text-[hsl(var(--primary-foreground)/.62)]"><MapPin size={12} /> {summary.location}</div><h1 className="font-[family-name:var(--app-font-serif)] text-[31px] font-bold tracking-[-.045em] sm:text-[42px]">{summary.farmName}</h1><p className="mt-2 max-w-md text-sm text-[hsl(var(--primary-foreground)/.68)]">{summary.dateLabel} ¬∑ A clear view of what needs tending.</p></div><div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-white/[.08] p-4 sm:min-w-[188px]"><div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.14em] text-white/60"><span>Today's rhythm</span><CalendarDays size={14} /></div><div className="font-[family-name:var(--app-font-serif)] text-3xl font-bold">{done}<span className="text-lg text-white/45">/{summary.tasks.length}</span></div><div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-white/60">jobs signed off</div></div></div>
    </div>
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
      <Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Living stock" value={summary.livestock.total} note={`${summary.livestock.goats} goats ¬∑ ${summary.livestock.chickens} chickens`} tone="green" /></Panel>
      <Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Water reserve" value={`${summary.water.percentFull}%`} note={`${summary.water.currentLitres.toLocaleString()}L of ${summary.water.capacityLitres.toLocaleString()}L`} tone={summary.water.percentFull < 30 ? 'red' : 'green'} /><Meter value={summary.water.percentFull} color={summary.water.percentFull < 30 ? 'red' : 'primary'} /></Panel>
      <Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Due today" value={summary.tasksDueToday} note={`${summary.overdueTasks} overdue`} tone={summary.overdueTasks ? 'red' : 'gold'} /></Panel>
      <Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Month to date" value={money(summary.monthlyProfit)} note={`${money(summary.monthlyRevenue)} revenue`} tone="green" /></Panel>
    </div>
    <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_1.55fr_1fr]">
      <Panel className="animate-rise delay-1"><PanelTitle eyebrow="Field book ¬∑ today" title="Today's work" action={<SectionLink href="/today">Open list</SectionLink>} /><div className="space-y-1 p-3">{summary.tasks.slice(0, 5).map(task => <TaskRow key={task.id} task={task} compact />)}{summary.tasks.length === 0 && <EmptyState title="A clean slate" detail="There is nothing waiting for the team today." />}</div></Panel>
      <Panel className="animate-rise delay-2"><PanelTitle eyebrow="A quick read" title="The farm at a glance" /><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-px overflow-hidden p-3 sm:grid-cols-3">{glance.map(({ label, value, href, Icon }, i) => <button data-testid={`button-glance-${label.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')}`} key={label} onClick={() => setLocation(href)} className={`group flex min-h-[94px] flex-col justify-between p-3 text-left transition hover:bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.45)] ${i % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-[hsl(var(--background)/.45)]' : ''}`}><Icon size={17} className="text-[hsl(var(--primary))]" /><div><div className="font-[family-name:var(--app-font-serif)] text-2xl font-bold">{value}</div><div className="text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{label}</div></div></button>)}</div></Panel>
      <Panel className="animate-rise delay-3"><PanelTitle eyebrow="Watch closely" title="Active alerts" action={<SectionLink href="/alerts">See all</SectionLink>} /><div className="space-y-3 p-4">{summary.alerts.slice(0, 3).map(alert => <AlertRow key={alert.id} alert={alert} />)}{summary.alerts.length === 0 && <EmptyState title="No alerts" detail="Everything is within its normal range." />}</div></Panel>
    </div>
    <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[1.3fr_1fr]">
      <Panel><PanelTitle eyebrow="Zim dollars ¬∑ month to date" title="Cash position" action={<SectionLink href="/finance">Finance view</SectionLink>} /><div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 p-4 sm:p-5"><Stat label="Revenue" value={money(summary.monthlyRevenue)} tone="green" /><Stat label="Expenses" value={money(summary.monthlyExpenses)} tone="red" /><Stat label="Profit" value={money(summary.monthlyProfit)} tone="gold" /></div><div className="mx-4 mb-5 flex h-14 items-end gap-1.5 sm:mx-5">{[42, 58, 49, 72, 61, 78, 68, 86, 73, 92, 81, 96].map((h, i) => <div key={i} className={`flex-1 rounded-t-sm ${i > 8 ? 'bg-[hsl(var(--primary))]' : 'bg-[hsl(var(--secondary))]'}`} style={{ height: `${h}%` }} />)}</div></Panel>
      <Panel><PanelTitle eyebrow="Latest notes" title="Recent activity" /><div className="space-y-4 p-4">{summary.recentActivity.slice(0, 4).map((a, i) => <div data-testid={`activity-${a.id}`} key={a.id} className="flex gap-3"><div className="mt-1 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[hsl(var(--accent))]" /><div><div className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{a.title}</div><div className="text-[11px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{a.detail} ¬∑ {a.timestamp}</div></div></div>)}</div></Panel>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

function TaskRow({ task, compact = false, onComplete }: { task: Task; compact?: boolean; onComplete?: (id: number) => void }) {
  const completed = task.status === 'completed';
  return <div data-testid={`row-task-${task.id}`} className={`group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-2 py-2.5 transition hover:bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.45)] ${completed ? 'opacity-55' : ''}`}><button data-testid={`button-complete-task-${task.id}`} onClick={() => onComplete?.(task.id)} disabled={completed} className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 transition ${completed ? 'border-[hsl(var(--primary))] bg-[hsl(var(--primary))] text-white animate-check' : 'border-[hsl(var(--border))] hover:border-[hsl(var(--primary))]'}`}>{completed && <Check size={14} strokeWidth={3} />}</button><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><div className={`truncate text-[12px] font-semibold ${completed ? 'line-through' : ''}`}>{task.title}</div><div className="mt-0.5 flex gap-2 text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]"><span>{task.farmUnit}</span>{task.dueTime && <span>¬∑ {task.dueTime}</span>}</div></div><Badge tone={toneFor(task.priority) as 'green' | 'gold' | 'red'}>{task.priority}</Badge>{!compact && <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{date(task.dueDate)}</span>}</div>;
}

function AlertRow({ alert }: { alert: Alert }) { return <div data-testid={`row-alert-${alert.id}`} className="flex gap-3"><div className={`mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${alert.severity === 'critical' || alert.severity === 'high' ? 'bg-[#f5d8d3] text-[hsl(var(--destructive))]' : 'bg-[#f9e6ae] text-[#795811]'}`}><ShieldAlert size={15} /></div><div className="min-w-0"><div className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{alert.title}</div><p className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{alert.detail}</p>{alert.dueLabel && <div className="mt-1 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase text-[hsl(var(--destructive))]">{alert.dueLabel}</div>}</div></div>; }

export function TodayPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useListTasks();
  const tasks = data || [];
  const complete = useCompleteTask();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');
  const visible = tasks.filter(t => filter === 'all' || t.status === filter);
  const onComplete = (id: number) => complete.mutate({ taskId: id, data: {} }, { onSuccess: () => client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListTasksQueryKey() }) });
  if (isLoading) return <Loading rows={6} />; if (isError) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />;
  return <div className="animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Monday ¬∑ field book" title="Today's work" detail="The short list that keeps Boroma Hills moving." action={<SectionLink href="/tasks">Manage tasks</SectionLink>} /><div className="mb-5 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none">{[['all', 'All work'], ['pending', 'To do'], ['completed', 'Signed off']].map(([v, l]) => <button data-testid={`button-filter-${v}`} key={v} onClick={() => setFilter(v)} className={`whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold ${filter === v ? 'border-[hsl(var(--primary))] bg-[hsl(var(--primary))] text-white' : 'border-[hsl(var(--border))] bg-[hsl(var(--card))]'}`}>{l} <span className="ml-1 opacity-60">{v === 'all' ? tasks.length : tasks.filter(t => t.status === v).length}</span></button>)}</div><Panel className="max-w-3xl"><div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[hsl(var(--border))] px-4 py-3 sm:px-5"><div className="text-sm font-semibold">{visible.filter(t => t.status === 'completed').length} of {visible.length} complete</div><Meter value={visible.length ? visible.filter(t => t.status === 'completed').length / visible.length * 100 : 0} /><span className="ml-4 font-mono text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}</span></div><div className="divide-y divide-[hsl(var(--border))] p-2">{visible.map(task => <TaskRow key={task.id} task={task} onComplete={onComplete} />)}{visible.length === 0 && <EmptyState title="Nothing in this view" detail="Try another filter, or add a task to the day's book." />}</div></Panel></div>;
}

export function FarmMapPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useListFarmZones({ query: { queryKey: getListFarmZonesQueryKey() } });
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<FarmZone | null>(null);
  if (isLoading) return <Loading rows={5} />; if (isError) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />;
  const zones = data || [];
  const palette: Record<string, string> = {
    clay: '#b9684d',
    amber: '#c98b25',
    sun: '#e1ae38',
    rose: '#be756d',
    sage: '#5e956f',
    blue: '#4b91a5',
    green: '#4d8b58',
    slate: '#65727b',
    orange: '#c4773c',
    cyan: '#3d9aa3',
    earth: '#8a6b4d',
  };
  const mapLayout: Record<string, { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number; compact?: boolean }> = {
    Farmhouse: { left: 2, top: 3, width: 96, height: 17 },
    "Field crops": { left: 2, top: 40, width: 48, height: 57 },
    "Goat paddock 1": { left: 53, top: 38, width: 18, height: 25 },
    "Goat paddock 2": { left: 53, top: 69, width: 18, height: 25 },
    "Free-range chickens": { left: 75, top: 38, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    "Broiler area": { left: 87, top: 38, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    Piggery: { left: 75, top: 50, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    "Fish tank 1": { left: 87, top: 50, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    "Fish tank 2": { left: 75, top: 62, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    "Future greenhouse": { left: 87, top: 62, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    "Home garden": { left: 75, top: 74, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    "Commercial vegetable garden": { left: 87, top: 74, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    Orchard: { left: 75, top: 86, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    "5,000L JoJo tank": { left: 87, top: 86, width: 10, height: 10, compact: true },
    "Compost & manure": { left: 75, top: 94, width: 10, height: 4, compact: true },
    "Equipment storage": { left: 87, top: 94, width: 10, height: 4, compact: true },
  };
  const zoneColor = (zone: FarmZone) => palette[zone.accent || ''] || '#35725c';
  const getZone = (name: string) => zones.find(zone => zone.name === name);
  const mapZones = zones.filter(zone => mapLayout[zone.name]);
  return <div className="animate-rise">
    <PageHeading eyebrow="Production plan ¬∑ measured site" title="Farm map" detail="A north-up plan of the 100m √ó 200m holding. Tap any area to see its record." />
    <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-5 gap-y-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[.12em] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#5e956f]" /> Livestock</span>
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#c98b25]" /> Poultry & projects</span>
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#4d8b58]" /> Fields & gardens</span>
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#4b91a5]" /> Water</span>
    </div>
    <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[1.55fr_1fr]">
      <Panel className="paper-grid overflow-hidden p-3 sm:p-5">
        <div className="relative mx-auto aspect-[1/1.55] max-h-[760px] min-h-[650px] w-full max-w-[620px] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-[hsl(var(--primary)/.35)] bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.28)]">
          <div className="absolute inset-x-3 top-2 flex items-start justify-between font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[.14em] text-[hsl(var(--primary))] sm:inset-x-5 sm:top-3">
            <span>Boroma Hills ¬∑ 100m √ó 200m</span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="text-sm">‚Üë</span> North</span>
          </div>
          <div className="absolute left-[2%] top-[21%] h-px w-[96%] bg-[hsl(var(--primary)/.22)]" />
          <div className="absolute left-[2%] top-[35%] flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[8px] uppercase tracking-[.12em] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]"><span className="h-px w-4 bg-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground)/.45)]" /> service / project belt</div>
          <div className="absolute left-[53%] top-[65%] flex h-[4%] w-[18%] items-center justify-center border-y border-dashed border-[#9a774d]/70 bg-[#b99563]/20 font-mono text-[8px] uppercase tracking-[.14em] text-[#765c3b] [writing-mode:vertical-rl] sm:[writing-mode:horizontal-tb]">service road</div>
          <div className="absolute bottom-[1.5%] left-[2%] font-mono text-[8px] uppercase tracking-[.12em] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">South ¬∑ remaining fields area</div>
          {mapZones.map(zone => {
            const layout = mapLayout[zone.name];
            const color = zoneColor(zone);
            return <button data-testid={`button-zone-${zone.id}`} key={zone.id} onClick={() => setSelected(zone)} className={`absolute overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 p-2 text-left shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)] transition hover:z-20 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[var(--shadow-md)] ${layout.compact ? 'rounded-lg' : 'rounded-2xl p-3'}`} style={{ left: `${layout.left}%`, top: `${layout.top}%`, width: `${layout.width}%`, height: `${layout.height}%`, borderColor: color, backgroundColor: `${color}20` }}>
              {layout.compact ? <><div className="truncate text-[9px] font-bold leading-tight sm:text-[10px]">{zone.name.replace('Free-range chickens', 'Free-range').replace('Commercial vegetable garden', 'Veg garden').replace('Future greenhouse', 'Greenhouse').replace('5,000L JoJo tank', 'JoJo tank')}</div><div className="mt-1 truncate font-mono text-[7px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{zone.dimensions || zone.type}</div></> : <><div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between"><Sprout size={layout.width > 30 ? 17 : 14} style={{ color }} /><MoreHorizontal size={15} /></div><div className="text-[11px] font-bold sm:text-[12px]">{zone.name}</div><div className="mt-1 text-[9px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{zone.dimensions || zone.type}</div></>}
            </button>;
          })}
          {getZone('Goat paddock 1') && <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-[53%] top-[36%] font-mono text-[8px] uppercase tracking-[.1em] text-[hsl(var(--primary))]">Goat block ¬∑ east</div>}
        </div>
      </Panel>
      <Panel><PanelTitle eyebrow={`${zones.length} configured zones`} title="Zone register" /><div className="space-y-1 p-3">{zones.map(z => <button data-testid={`button-zone-register-${z.id}`} key={z.id} onClick={() => setSelected(z)} className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-3 text-left hover:bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.5)]"><span className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: zoneColor(z) }} /><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><div className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{z.name}</div><div className="text-[10px] capitalize text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{z.type} ¬∑ {z.dimensions || 'Size not set'}</div></div><Badge tone={toneFor(z.status) as 'green' | 'gold' | 'red'}>{z.status}</Badge></button>)}</div></Panel>
    </div>
    {selected && <Modal title={selected.name} onClose={() => setSelected(null)}><div className="space-y-4"><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><Stat label="Type" value={selected.type} /><Stat label="Status" value={selected.status} /></div><div className="rounded-xl bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.55)] p-4 text-sm"><span className="font-semibold">Dimensions</span><div className="mt-1 text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{selected.dimensions || 'No dimensions recorded yet.'}</div></div><Button className="w-full" onClick={() => setSelected(null)}>Done</Button></div></Modal>}
  </div>;
}

export function LivestockPage() {
  const { data: summary, isLoading: summaryLoading } = useGetLivestockSummary({ query: { queryKey: getGetLivestockSummaryQueryKey() } });
  const { data: goats } = useListGoats();
  const { data: flocks } = useListPoultryFlocks({ query: { queryKey: getListPoultryFlocksQueryKey() } });
  return <div className="animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Living stock" title="Livestock" detail="Count, condition, and the next thing to look for." action={<div className="flex gap-2"><SectionLink href="/livestock/goats">Goat register</SectionLink><SectionLink href="/livestock/poultry">Poultry batches</SectionLink></div>} />{summaryLoading ? <Loading rows={3} /> : <><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4"><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Total animals" value={summary?.total || 0} tone="green" /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Goats" value={summary?.goats || goats?.length || 0} note={`${summary?.pregnantGoats || 0} pregnant`} /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Poultry" value={(summary?.chickens || 0) + (summary?.broilers || 0)} note={`${summary?.broilers || 0} broilers`} tone="gold" /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Needs care" value={summary?.sickAnimals || 0} note="health flags" tone={summary?.sickAnimals ? 'red' : 'green'} /></Panel></div><div className="mt-5 grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2"><Panel><PanelTitle title="Goat herd" eyebrow="Individual register" action={<SectionLink href="/livestock/goats">Open register</SectionLink>} /><div className="space-y-2 p-4">{(goats || []).slice(0, 4).map(g => <GoatLine key={g.id} goat={g} />)}{!goats?.length && <EmptyState title="No goats recorded" detail="Start the register with your first animal." />}</div></Panel><Panel><PanelTitle title="Poultry on hand" eyebrow="Flocks & batches" action={<SectionLink href="/livestock/poultry">Open batches</SectionLink>} /><div className="space-y-2 p-4">{(flocks || []).slice(0, 4).map(f => <FlockLine key={f.id} flock={f} />)}{!flocks?.length && <EmptyState title="No flocks recorded" detail="Your poultry batches will appear here." />}</div></Panel></div></>}</div>;
}

function GoatLine({ goat }: { goat: Goat }) { return <div data-testid={`row-goat-${goat.id}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[hsl(var(--border))] p-3"><div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[hsl(var(--secondary))] text-[hsl(var(--primary))]"><Egg size={18} /></div><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><div className="text-[12px] font-bold">{goat.name} <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-normal text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{goat.goatId}</span></div><div className="text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{goat.breed} ¬∑ {goat.paddock}</div></div><Badge tone={toneFor(goat.healthStatus) as 'green' | 'gold' | 'red'}>{goat.healthStatus}</Badge></div>; }
function FlockLine({ flock }: { flock: PoultryFlock }) { return <div data-testid={`row-flock-${flock.id}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[hsl(var(--border))] p-3"><div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#f9e6ae] text-[#795811]"><Bird size={18} /></div><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><div className="text-[12px] font-bold">{flock.batchId}</div><div className="text-[10px] capitalize text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{flock.kind} ¬∑ {flock.breed}</div></div><div className="text-right"><div className="font-mono text-sm font-bold">{flock.currentQuantity}</div><div className="text-[9px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">birds</div></div></div>; }

export function GoatsPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useListGoats();
  const create = useCreateGoat(); const client = useQueryClient(); const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const submit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => { e.preventDefault(); const f = new FormData(e.currentTarget); create.mutate({ data: { goatId: String(f.get('goatId')), name: String(f.get('name')), sex: String(f.get('sex')), breed: String(f.get('breed')), paddock: String(f.get('paddock')), dateOfBirth: String(f.get('dateOfBirth') || ''), currentWeightKg: Number(f.get('currentWeightKg')) || undefined, pregnancyStatus: String(f.get('pregnancyStatus')), expectedKiddingDate: String(f.get('expectedKiddingDate') || ''), healthStatus: String(f.get('healthStatus')) } }, { onSuccess: () => { client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListGoatsQueryKey() }); setOpen(false); } }); };
  if (isLoading) return <Loading rows={6} />; if (isError) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />;
  return <div className="animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Living stock / goats" title="Goat register" detail={`${data?.length || 0} individual records ¬∑ pregnancy and health in one view`} action={<Button data-testid="button-add-goat" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}><Plus size={16} /> Add goat</Button>} /><Panel><div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[hsl(var(--border))] p-4"><div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"><Filter size={15} className="text-[hsl(var(--primary))]" /> Herd records</div><Badge tone="gold">{(data || []).filter(g => g.pregnancyStatus?.toLowerCase().includes('preg')).length} pregnant</Badge></div><div className="grid gap-3 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">{(data || []).map(g => <GoatCard key={g.id} goat={g} />)}{!data?.length && <div className="sm:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3"><EmptyState title="The goat register is empty" detail="Add your first doe or buck to begin tracking the herd." onAdd={() => setOpen(true)} /></div>}</div></Panel>{open && <Modal title="Add a goat" onClose={() => setOpen(false)}><form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4"><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><FormField label="Goat ID" name="goatId" placeholder="BH-G-014" required /><FormField label="Name" name="name" placeholder="Mauya" required /></div><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><SelectField label="Sex" name="sex" options={['female', 'male']} required /><FormField label="Breed" name="breed" placeholder="Matabele" required /></div><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><FormField label="Paddock" name="paddock" placeholder="Paddock 2" required /><FormField label="Weight (kg)" name="currentWeightKg" type="number" placeholder="42" /></div><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><SelectField label="Pregnancy" name="pregnancyStatus" options={['not pregnant', 'pregnant', 'unknown']} /><SelectField label="Health" name="healthStatus" options={['healthy', 'watch', 'sick']} /></div><FormField label="Date of birth" name="dateOfBirth" type="date" /><SaveButton pending={create.isPending}>Save goat</SaveButton></form></Modal>}</div>;
}
function GoatCard({ goat }: { goat: Goat }) { return <div data-testid={`card-goat-${goat.id}`} className="rounded-2xl border border-[hsl(var(--border))] p-4 transition hover:shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)]"><div className="mb-5 flex items-start justify-between"><div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[hsl(var(--secondary))] text-[hsl(var(--primary))]"><Egg size={21} /></div><Badge tone={toneFor(goat.status) as 'green' | 'gold' | 'red'}>{goat.status}</Badge></div><div className="font-[family-name:var(--app-font-serif)] text-xl font-bold">{goat.name}</div><div className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{goat.goatId} ¬∑ {goat.sex} ¬∑ {goat.breed}</div><div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-[hsl(var(--border))] pt-3"><div><div className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">Paddock</div><div className="mt-1 text-[12px] font-semibold">{goat.paddock}</div></div><div><div className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">Weight</div><div className="mt-1 text-[12px] font-semibold">{goat.currentWeightKg ? `${goat.currentWeightKg} kg` : 'Not logged'}</div></div></div>{goat.pregnancyStatus?.toLowerCase().includes('preg') && <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-[#f9e6ae]/65 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#795811]">Expected kidding {date(goat.expectedKiddingDate)}{goat.daysRemaining ? ` ¬∑ ${goat.daysRemaining} days` : ''}</div>}</div>; }

export function PoultryPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useListPoultryFlocks({ query: { queryKey: getListPoultryFlocksQueryKey() } });
  if (isLoading) return <Loading rows={5} />; if (isError) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />;
  const flocks = data || []; const birds = flocks.reduce((a, f) => a + f.currentQuantity, 0); const feed = flocks.reduce((a, f) => a + f.feedKg, 0);
  return <div className="animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Living stock / poultry" title="Poultry batches" detail="Flocks, feed, mortality, and sale windows." /><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4"><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Birds on hand" value={birds} tone="green" /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Active batches" value={flocks.length} /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Feed logged" value={`${feed} kg`} tone="gold" /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Mortality" value={flocks.reduce((a, f) => a + f.mortality, 0)} note="birds this cycle" tone="red" /></Panel></div><Panel className="mt-5"><PanelTitle eyebrow="Current register" title="All batches" /><div className="overflow-x-auto"><table className="w-full min-w-[700px] text-left"><thead><tr className="border-b border-[hsl(var(--border))] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]"><th className="px-5 py-3">Batch</th><th>Kind & breed</th><th>Quantity</th><th>Avg. weight</th><th>Sale date</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>{flocks.map(f => <tr data-testid={`row-poultry-${f.id}`} key={f.id} className="border-b border-[hsl(var(--border))] last:border-0 hover:bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.25)]"><td className="px-5 py-4 font-mono text-[12px] font-bold">{f.batchId}</td><td><div className="text-[12px] font-semibold capitalize">{f.kind}</div><div className="text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{f.breed}</div></td><td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{f.currentQuantity}<span className="text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]"> / {f.startingQuantity}</span></td><td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{f.averageWeightKg ? `${f.averageWeightKg} kg` : '‚Äî'}</td><td className="text-[12px]">{date(f.expectedSaleDate)}</td><td><Badge tone={toneFor(f.status) as 'green' | 'gold' | 'red'}>{f.status}</Badge></td></tr>)}{!flocks.length && <tr><td colSpan={6} className="p-4"><EmptyState title="No poultry batches" detail="Batches will become your day-to-day production view." /></td></tr>}</tbody></table></div></Panel></div>;
}

export function InventoryPage() {
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('all'); const [lowOnly, setLowOnly] = useState(false); const [modal, setModal] = useState<'add' | 'transaction' | null>(null); const [selected, setSelected] = useState<InventoryItem | null>(null);
  const params = useMemo(() => ({ ...(category !== 'all' ? { category } : {}), ...(lowOnly ? { lowStock: true } : {}) }), [category, lowOnly]);
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useListInventory(params, { query: { queryKey: getListInventoryQueryKey(params) } });
  const create = useCreateInventoryItem(); const transaction = useRecordInventoryTransaction(); const client = useQueryClient();
  const add = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => { e.preventDefault(); const f = new FormData(e.currentTarget); create.mutate({ data: { itemId: String(f.get('itemId')), name: String(f.get('name')), category: String(f.get('category')), unit: String(f.get('unit')), quantity: Number(f.get('quantity')), minimumStock: Number(f.get('minimumStock')), maximumStock: Number(f.get('maximumStock')), supplier: String(f.get('supplier') || ''), purchasePrice: Number(f.get('purchasePrice')) || undefined, storageLocation: String(f.get('storageLocation') || '') } }, { onSuccess: () => { client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListInventoryQueryKey() }); setModal(null); } }); };
  const transact = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!selected) return; const f = new FormData(e.currentTarget); transaction.mutate({ itemId: selected.id, data: { type: String(f.get('type')) as 'purchase' | 'usage' | 'adjustment' | 'waste' | 'expired', quantity: Number(f.get('quantity')), note: String(f.get('note') || '') } }, { onSuccess: () => { client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListInventoryQueryKey() }); setModal(null); setSelected(null); } }); };
  if (isLoading) return <Loading rows={6} />; if (isError) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />; const items = data || [];
  return <div className="animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Stores & supplies" title="Inventory" detail="Know what is on the shelf before it becomes urgent." action={<Button data-testid="button-add-inventory" onClick={() => setModal('add')}><Plus size={16} /> Add item</Button>} /><div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2"><div className="flex overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-[hsl(var(--border))] bg-[hsl(var(--card))]">{['all', 'feed', 'veterinary', 'fuel', 'supplies'].map(c => <button data-testid={`button-category-${c}`} key={c} onClick={() => setCategory(c)} className={`px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold capitalize ${category === c ? 'bg-[hsl(var(--primary))] text-white' : ''}`}>{c}</button>)}</div><button data-testid="button-filter-low-stock" onClick={() => setLowOnly(!lowOnly)} className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold ${lowOnly ? 'border-[hsl(var(--destructive))] bg-[#f5d8d3] text-[hsl(var(--destructive))]' : 'border-[hsl(var(--border))] bg-[hsl(var(--card))]'}`}><CircleAlert size={14} /> Low stock only</button></div><Panel><div className="hidden overflow-x-auto sm:block"><table className="w-full min-w-[760px] text-left"><thead><tr className="border-b border-[hsl(var(--border))] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]"><th className="px-5 py-3">Item</th><th>Category</th><th>On hand</th><th>Stock band</th><th>Supplier</th><th /></tr></thead><tbody>{items.map(item => <InventoryRow key={item.id} item={item} onTransact={() => { setSelected(item); setModal('transaction'); }} />)}</tbody></table></div><div className="space-y-2 p-3 sm:hidden">{items.map(item => <InventoryMobileRow key={item.id} item={item} onTransact={() => { setSelected(item); setModal('transaction'); }} />)}</div>{!items.length && <div className="p-3"><EmptyState title="The store ledger is empty" detail="Add feed, supplies, fuel, or medicine to keep an eye on levels." onAdd={() => setModal('add')} /></div>}</Panel>{modal === 'add' && <Modal title="Add inventory item" onClose={() => setModal(null)}><form onSubmit={add} className="space-y-4"><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><FormField label="Item ID" name="itemId" placeholder="FEED-07" required /><FormField label="Item name" name="name" placeholder="Layer mash" required /></div><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><SelectField label="Category" name="category" options={['feed', 'veterinary', 'fuel', 'supplies']} required /><FormField label="Unit" name="unit" placeholder="kg" required /></div><div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2"><FormField label="Quantity" name="quantity" type="number" placeholder="0" required /><FormField label="Minimum" name="minimumStock" type="number" placeholder="10" required /><FormField label="Maximum" name="maximumStock" type="number" placeholder="100" required /></div><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><FormField label="Supplier" name="supplier" placeholder="Chinhoyi Feed Mill" /><FormField label="Price per unit" name="purchasePrice" type="number" placeholder="12.50" /></div><FormField label="Storage location" name="storageLocation" placeholder="Store room A" /><SaveButton pending={create.isPending}>Save item</SaveButton></form></Modal>}{modal === 'transaction' && selected && <Modal title={`Record ${selected.name}`} onClose={() => { setModal(null); setSelected(null); }}><div className="mb-4 rounded-xl bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.6)] p-3 text-sm"><b>{selected.quantity} {selected.unit}</b> currently on hand ¬∑ minimum {selected.minimumStock} {selected.unit}</div><form onSubmit={transact} className="space-y-4"><SelectField label="Transaction" name="type" options={['purchase', 'usage', 'adjustment', 'waste', 'expired']} required /><FormField label={`Quantity (${selected.unit})`} name="quantity" type="number" placeholder="1" required /><FormField label="Note" name="note" placeholder="Weekly feed issue" /><SaveButton pending={transaction.isPending}>Record movement</SaveButton></form></Modal>}</div>;
}
function InventoryRow({ item, onTransact }: { item: InventoryItem; onTransact: () => void }) { const pct = item.maximumStock ? item.quantity / item.maximumStock * 100 : 0; return <tr data-testid={`row-inventory-${item.id}`} className="border-b border-[hsl(var(--border))] last:border-0 hover:bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.25)]"><td className="px-5 py-4"><div className="text-[12px] font-bold">{item.name}</div><div className="font-mono text-[9px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{item.itemId} ¬∑ {item.storageLocation || 'Location not set'}</div></td><td><Badge tone="neutral">{item.category}</Badge></td><td><span className={`font-mono text-[13px] font-bold ${item.isLowStock ? 'text-[hsl(var(--destructive))]' : ''}`}>{item.quantity}</span> <span className="text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{item.unit}</span></td><td className="w-36"><Meter value={pct} color={item.isLowStock ? 'red' : 'primary'} /><div className="mt-1 text-[9px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{item.minimumStock} min ¬∑ {item.maximumStock} max</div></td><td className="text-[11px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{item.supplier || '‚Äî'}</td><td className="pr-4 text-right"><Button variant="ghost" className="min-h-8 px-2.5 text-[11px]" onClick={onTransact}><ArrowUpRight size={13} /> Move</Button></td></tr>; }
function InventoryMobileRow({ item, onTransact }: { item: InventoryItem; onTransact: () => void }) { return <div data-testid={`card-inventory-${item.id}`} className="rounded-2xl border border-[hsl(var(--border))] p-3.5"><div className="flex items-start justify-between"><div><div className="text-[13px] font-bold">{item.name}</div><div className="font-mono text-[9px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{item.itemId} ¬∑ {item.category}</div></div><Badge tone={item.isLowStock ? 'red' : 'green'}>{item.isLowStock ? 'low stock' : 'healthy'}</Badge></div><div className="mt-4 flex items-end justify-between"><div><span className="font-[family-name:var(--app-font-serif)] text-2xl font-bold">{item.quantity}</span> <span className="text-[11px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{item.unit}</span><div className="mt-2 w-36"><Meter value={item.maximumStock ? item.quantity / item.maximumStock * 100 : 0} color={item.isLowStock ? 'red' : 'primary'} /></div></div><Button variant="ghost" className="min-h-8 px-2.5 text-[11px]" onClick={onTransact}><ArrowUpRight size={13} /> Record</Button></div></div>; }

export function TasksPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useListTasks(); const create = useCreateTask(); const complete = useCompleteTask(); const client = useQueryClient(); const [search, setSearch] = useState(''); const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const tasks = (data || []).filter(t => `${t.title} ${t.farmUnit} ${t.assignedTo || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
  const submit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => { e.preventDefault(); const f = new FormData(e.currentTarget); create.mutate({ data: { title: String(f.get('title')), description: String(f.get('description') || ''), farmUnit: String(f.get('farmUnit')), priority: String(f.get('priority')), dueDate: String(f.get('dueDate')), dueTime: String(f.get('dueTime') || ''), recurrence: String(f.get('recurrence') || ''), assignedTo: String(f.get('assignedTo') || '') } }, { onSuccess: () => { client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListTasksQueryKey() }); setOpen(false); } }); };
  if (isLoading) return <Loading rows={6} />; if (isError) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />;
  return <div className="animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Field book / actions" title="Tasks" detail="A searchable list of every job, large or small." action={<Button data-testid="button-create-task" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}><Plus size={16} /> New task</Button>} /><div className="mb-4 flex max-w-xl items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[hsl(var(--border))] bg-[hsl(var(--card))] px-3"><Search size={16} className="text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]" /><input data-testid="input-search-tasks" value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search tasks, units, or people" className="h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-sm outline-none" /></div><Panel><div className="divide-y divide-[hsl(var(--border))] p-2">{tasks.map(t => <TaskRow key={t.id} task={t} onComplete={id => complete.mutate({ taskId: id, data: {} }, { onSuccess: () => client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListTasksQueryKey() }) })} />)}{!tasks.length && <EmptyState title="No tasks found" detail={search ? 'Try a different search.' : 'Your team has a quiet book today.'} onAdd={() => setOpen(true)} />}</div></Panel>{open && <Modal title="Create a task" onClose={() => setOpen(false)}><form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4"><FormField label="Task title" name="title" placeholder="Check west paddock fence" required /><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><FormField label="Farm unit" name="farmUnit" placeholder="Goats" required /><SelectField label="Priority" name="priority" options={['low', 'normal', 'high']} /></div><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><FormField label="Due date" name="dueDate" type="date" required /><FormField label="Due time" name="dueTime" type="time" /></div><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><FormField label="Assigned to" name="assignedTo" placeholder="Tendai" /><SelectField label="Recurrence" name="recurrence" options={['none', 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly']} /></div><FormField label="Description" name="description" placeholder="What good looks like‚Ä¶" /><SaveButton pending={create.isPending}>Add task</SaveButton></form></Modal>}</div>;
}

export function FinancePage() {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useGetFinanceSummary({ query: { queryKey: getGetFinanceSummaryQueryKey() } });
  if (isLoading) return <Loading rows={5} />; if (isError || !data) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />; const finance = data as FinanceSummary; const max = Math.max(...finance.monthly.map(m => Math.max(m.revenue, m.expenses)), 1);
  return <div className="animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Money in / money out" title="Finance" detail="The business view, without losing the farm underneath it." /><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4"><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Revenue" value={money(finance.revenue)} note={`${finance.revenueChange >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${finance.revenueChange}% vs last month`} tone="green" /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Expenses" value={money(finance.expenses)} note={`${finance.expenseChange >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${finance.expenseChange}% vs last month`} tone="red" /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Net profit" value={money(finance.profit)} tone="gold" /></Panel><Panel className="p-4"><Stat label="Margin" value={`${finance.revenue ? Math.round(finance.profit / finance.revenue * 100) : 0}%`} note="across all enterprises" tone="green" /></Panel></div><div className="mt-5 grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr]"><Panel><PanelTitle eyebrow="Last six months" title="Trading line" /><div className="p-5"><div className="flex h-56 items-end gap-2 border-b border-l border-[hsl(var(--border))] px-2 pb-0">{finance.monthly.map((m, i) => <div key={m.month} className="flex h-full flex-1 items-end justify-center gap-1"><div title={`${m.revenue} revenue`} className="w-[42%] rounded-t-sm bg-[hsl(var(--primary))] transition-all hover:opacity-75" style={{ height: `${m.revenue / max * 100}%` }} /><div title={`${m.expenses} expenses`} className="w-[42%] rounded-t-sm bg-[hsl(var(--accent))] transition-all hover:opacity-75" style={{ height: `${m.expenses / max * 100}%` }} /></div>)}</div><div className="mt-3 flex justify-between pl-2 text-[9px] font-mono text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{finance.monthly.map(m => <span key={m.month}>{m.month.slice(0, 3)}</span>)}</div><div className="mt-4 flex gap-4 text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]"><span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><i className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-[hsl(var(--primary))]" /> Revenue</span><span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><i className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-[hsl(var(--accent))]" /> Expenses</span></div></div></Panel><Panel><PanelTitle eyebrow="Where it comes from" title="Enterprise performance" /><div className="space-y-4 p-5">{finance.enterprisePerformance.map(e => <div data-testid={`row-enterprise-${e.name}`} key={e.name}><div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between"><span className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{e.name}</span><span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-[hsl(var(--primary))]">{money(e.profit)}</span></div><Meter value={e.revenue ? e.profit / e.revenue * 100 : 0} /><div className="mt-1 flex justify-between text-[9px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]"><span>{money(e.revenue)} revenue</span><span>{Math.round(e.margin)}% margin</span></div></div>)}{!finance.enterprisePerformance.length && <EmptyState title="No enterprise data" detail="Revenue lines will appear once records are posted." />}</div></Panel></div></div>;
}

export function AlertsPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useListAlerts({ query: { queryKey: getListAlertsQueryKey() } });
  if (isLoading) return <Loading rows={5} />; if (isError) return <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />; const alerts = data || [];
  return <div className="animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Operational watch" title="Alerts" detail="The things worth knowing before the next round." /><div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-[hsl(var(--border))] bg-[hsl(var(--card))] p-4"><div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#f5d8d3] text-[hsl(var(--destructive))]"><CircleAlert size={18} /></div><div><div className="text-sm font-bold">{alerts.length} active {alerts.length === 1 ? 'alert' : 'alerts'}</div><div className="text-[11px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">Triage the urgent ones first. Notes stay until the source record changes.</div></div></div><div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">{alerts.map(alert => <Panel key={alert.id} className="p-5"><AlertRow alert={alert} /><div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[hsl(var(--border))] pt-3 text-[10px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]"><span className="capitalize">{alert.category}</span><Badge tone={alert.severity === 'high' || alert.severity === 'critical' ? 'red' : 'gold'}>{alert.severity}</Badge></div></Panel>)}{!alerts.length && <div className="lg:col-span-2"><EmptyState title="Clear skies over Boroma Hills" detail="No active alerts need your attention right now." /></div>}</div></div>;
}

export function SearchPage() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(''); const { data, isLoading } = useSearchFarm({ q: query }, { query: { enabled: query.trim().length > 1, queryKey: getSearchFarmQueryKey({ q: query }) } });
  const [, setLocation] = useLocation();
  return <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl animate-rise"><PageHeading eyebrow="Every record, one place" title="Search the farm" detail="Find animals, tasks, batches, supplies, and more." /><div className="mb-7 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border-2 border-[hsl(var(--primary)/.35)] bg-[hsl(var(--card))] px-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)]"><Search size={21} className="text-[hsl(var(--primary))]" /><input autoFocus data-testid="input-global-search" value={query} onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder="Try ‚Äúfeed‚Äù, ‚ÄúMauya‚Äù, or ‚Äúpaddock‚Äù" className="h-14 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-base outline-none" /></div>{query.length < 2 ? <div className="rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-[hsl(var(--border))] bg-[hsl(var(--card)/.55)] p-12 text-center"><Search className="mx-auto mb-4 text-[hsl(var(--primary))]" size={26} /><p className="font-[family-name:var(--app-font-serif)] text-xl font-bold">Start with a name or word</p><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">Search reaches across the farm's live records.</p></div> : isLoading ? <Loading rows={4} /> : <Panel><div className="border-b border-[hsl(var(--border))] px-5 py-4 text-sm font-semibold">{data?.length || 0} results for <span className="text-[hsl(var(--primary))]">‚Äú{query}‚Äù</span></div><div className="divide-y divide-[hsl(var(--border))]">{(data || []).map(result => <button data-testid={`button-search-result-${result.id}`} onClick={() => setLocation(result.module === 'tasks' ? '/tasks' : result.module === 'inventory' ? '/inventory' : result.module === 'goats' ? '/livestock/goats' : '/livestock')} key={result.id} className="flex w-full items-center gap-4 p-4 text-left transition hover:bg-[hsl(var(--secondary)/.4)]"><div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[hsl(var(--secondary))] text-[hsl(var(--primary))]">{result.kind === 'task' ? <Check size={18} /> : result.kind === 'inventory' ? <Package size={18} /> : result.kind === 'goat' ? <Egg size={18} /> : <Sprout size={18} />}</div><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><div className="text-[13px] font-bold">{result.title}</div><div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]">{result.subtitle}</div></div><Badge tone="neutral">{result.module}</Badge><ChevronRight size={16} className="text-[hsl(var(--muted-foreground))]" /></button>)}{!data?.length && <EmptyState title="No matching records" detail="Try a shorter word or check the spelling." />}</div></Panel>}</div>;
}

import * as React from "react"
import * as AlertDialogPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-alert-dialog"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"

const AlertDialog = AlertDialogPrimitive.Root

const AlertDialogTrigger = AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger

const AlertDialogPortal = AlertDialogPrimitive.Portal

const AlertDialogOverlay = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Overlay>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Overlay>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <AlertDialogPrimitive.Overlay
    className={cn(
      "fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
    ref={ref}
  />
))
AlertDialogOverlay.displayName = AlertDialogPrimitive.Overlay.displayName

const AlertDialogContent = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Content>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Content>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <AlertDialogPortal>
    <AlertDialogOverlay />
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Content
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        "fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-lg translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 border bg-background p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-left-1/2 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-top-[48%] data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-left-1/2 data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top-[48%] sm:rounded-lg",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  </AlertDialogPortal>
))
AlertDialogContent.displayName = AlertDialogPrimitive.Content.displayName

const AlertDialogHeader = ({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) => (
  <div
    className={cn(
      "flex flex-col space-y-2 text-center sm:text-left",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
)
AlertDialogHeader.displayName = "AlertDialogHeader"

const AlertDialogFooter = ({

  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) => (
  <div
    className={cn(

    {...props}
  />
)
AlertDialogFooter.displayName = "AlertDialogFooter"

import * as React from "react"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const alertVariants = cva(
  "relative w-full rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm [&>svg+div]:translate-y-[-3px] [&>svg]:absolute [&>svg]:left-4 [&>svg]:top-4 [&>svg]:text-foreground [&>svg~*]:pl-7",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-background text-foreground",
        destructive:
          "border-destructive/50 text-destructive dark:border-destructive [&>svg]:text-destructive",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

const Alert = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & VariantProps<typeof alertVariants>
>(({ className, variant, ...props }, ref) => (
  <div
    ref={ref}
    role="alert"
    className={cn(alertVariants({ variant }), className)}
    {...props}
  />
))
Alert.displayName = "Alert"

const AlertTitle = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <h5
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("mb-1 font-medium leading-none tracking-tight", className)}
    {...props}
  />
))
AlertTitle.displayName = "AlertTitle"

const AlertDescription = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <div
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("text-sm [&_p]:leading-relaxed", className)}
    {...props}
  />
))
AlertDescription.displayName = "AlertDescription"

export { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription }

BUSINESS FILE
FILE: C:\Users\Luke\Dev\BH-Farm-OS\lib\db\src\schema\farm.ts

import {
  boolean,
  date,
  integer,
  numeric,
  pgTable,
  serial,
  text,
  timestamp,
} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

export const farmZonesTable = pgTable("farm_zones", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  name: text("name").notNull(),
  type: text("type").notNull(),
  dimensions: text("dimensions"),
  status: text("status").notNull().default("Active"),
  accent: text("accent").notNull().default("sage"),
});

export const tasksTable = pgTable("farm_tasks", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  title: text("title").notNull(),
  description: text("description"),
  farmUnit: text("farm_unit").notNull(),
  priority: text("priority").notNull().default("Normal"),
  dueDate: date("due_date", { mode: "string" }).notNull(),
  dueTime: text("due_time"),
  recurrence: text("recurrence"),
  status: text("status").notNull().default("Pending"),
  completedAt: timestamp("completed_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  assignedTo: text("assigned_to"),
  notes: text("notes"),
});

export const goatsTable = pgTable("goats", {

export type CustomFetchOptions = RequestInit & {
  responseType?: "json" | "text" | "blob" | "auto";
};

export type ErrorType<T = unknown> = ApiError<T>;

export type BodyType<T> = T;

export type AuthTokenGetter = () => Promise<string | null> | string | null;

const NO_BODY_STATUS = new Set([204, 205, 304]);
const DEFAULT_JSON_ACCEPT = "application/json, application/problem+json";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Module-level configuration
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

let _baseUrl: string | null = null;
let _authTokenGetter: AuthTokenGetter | null = null;

/**
 * Set a base URL that is prepended to every relative request URL
 * (i.e. paths that start with `/`).
 *
 * Useful for Expo bundles that need to call a remote API server.
 * Pass `null` to clear the base URL.
 */
export function setBaseUrl(url: string | null): void {
  _baseUrl = url ? url.replace(/\/+$/, "") : null;
}

/**
 * Register a getter that supplies a bearer auth token.  Before every fetch
 * the getter is invoked; when it returns a non-null string, an
 * `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is attached to the request.
 *
 * Useful for Expo bundles making token-gated API calls.
 * Pass `null` to clear the getter.
 *
 * NOTE: This function should never be used in web applications where session
 * token cookies are automatically associated with API calls by the browser.
 */
export function setAuthTokenGetter(getter: AuthTokenGetter | null): void {
  _authTokenGetter = getter;
}

function isRequest(input: RequestInfo | URL): input is Request {
  return typeof Request !== "undefined" && input instanceof Request;
}

function resolveMethod(input: RequestInfo | URL, explicitMethod?: string): string {
  if (explicitMethod) return explicitMethod.toUpperCase();
  if (isRequest(input)) return input.method.toUpperCase();
  return "GET";
}

// Use loose check for URL ‚Äî some runtimes (e.g. React Native) polyfill URL
// differently, so `instanceof URL` can fail.
function isUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): input is URL {
  return typeof URL !== "undefined" && input instanceof URL;
}

function applyBaseUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): RequestInfo | URL {
  if (!_baseUrl) return input;
  const url = resolveUrl(input);
  // Only prepend to relative paths (starting with /)
  if (!url.startsWith("/")) return input;

  const absolute = `${_baseUrl}${url}`;
  if (typeof input === "string") return absolute;
  if (isUrl(input)) return new URL(absolute);
  return new Request(absolute, input as Request);
}

function resolveUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): string {
  if (typeof input === "string") return input;
  if (isUrl(input)) return input.toString();
  return input.url;
}

function mergeHeaders(...sources: Array<HeadersInit | undefined>): Headers {
  const headers = new Headers();

  for (const source of sources) {
    if (!source) continue;
    new Headers(source).forEach((value, key) => {
      headers.set(key, value);
    });
  }

  return headers;
}

function getMediaType(headers: Headers): string | null {
  const value = headers.get("content-type");
  return value ? value.split(";", 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase() : null;
}

function isJsonMediaType(mediaType: string | null): boolean {
  return mediaType === "application/json" || Boolean(mediaType?.endsWith("+json"));
}

function isTextMediaType(mediaType: string | null): boolean {
  return Boolean(
    mediaType &&
      (mediaType.startsWith("text/") ||
        mediaType === "application/xml" ||
        mediaType === "text/xml" ||
        mediaType.endsWith("+xml") ||
        mediaType === "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"),
  );
}

// Use strict equality: in browsers, `response.body` is `null` when the
// response genuinely has no content.  In React Native, `response.body` is
// always `undefined` because the ReadableStream API is not implemented ‚Äî
// even when the response carries a full payload readable via `.text()` or
// `.json()`.  Loose equality (`== null`) matches both `null` and `undefined`,
// which causes every React Native response to be treated as empty.
function hasNoBody(response: Response, method: string): boolean {
  if (method === "HEAD") return true;
  if (NO_BODY_STATUS.has(response.status)) return true;
  if (response.headers.get("content-length") === "0") return true;
  if (response.body === null) return true;
  return false;
}

function stripBom(text: string): string {
  return text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? text.slice(1) : text;
}

function looksLikeJson(text: string): boolean {
  const trimmed = text.trimStart();
  return trimmed.startsWith("{") || trimmed.startsWith("[");
}

function getStringField(value: unknown, key: string): string | undefined {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return undefined;

  const candidate = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
  if (typeof candidate !== "string") return undefined;

  const trimmed = candidate.trim();
  return trimmed === "" ? undefined : trimmed;
}

function truncate(text: string, maxLength = 300): string {
  return text.length > maxLength ? `${text.slice(0, maxLength - 1)}‚Ä¶` : text;
}

function buildErrorMessage(response: Response, data: unknown): string {
  const prefix = `HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;

  if (typeof data === "string") {
    const text = data.trim();
    return text ? `${prefix}: ${truncate(text)}` : prefix;
  }

  const title = getStringField(data, "title");
  const detail = getStringField(data, "detail");
  const message =
    getStringField(data, "message") ??
    getStringField(data, "error_description") ??
    getStringField(data, "error");

  if (title && detail) return `${prefix}: ${title} ‚Äî ${detail}`;
  if (detail) return `${prefix}: ${detail}`;
  if (message) return `${prefix}: ${message}`;
  if (title) return `${prefix}: ${title}`;

  return prefix;
}

export class ApiError<T = unknown> extends Error {
  readonly name = "ApiError";
  readonly status: number;
  readonly statusText: string;
  readonly data: T | null;
  readonly headers: Headers;
  readonly response: Response;
  readonly method: string;
  readonly url: string;

  constructor(
    response: Response,
    data: T | null,
    requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
  ) {
    super(buildErrorMessage(response, data));
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);

    this.status = response.status;
    this.statusText = response.statusText;
    this.data = data;
    this.headers = response.headers;
    this.response = response;
    this.method = requestInfo.method;
    this.url = response.url || requestInfo.url;
  }
}

export class ResponseParseError extends Error {
  readonly name = "ResponseParseError";
  readonly status: number;
  readonly statusText: string;
  readonly headers: Headers;
  readonly response: Response;
  readonly method: string;
  readonly url: string;
  readonly rawBody: string;
  readonly cause: unknown;

  constructor(
    response: Response,
    rawBody: string,
    cause: unknown,
    requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
  ) {
    super(
      `Failed to parse response from ${requestInfo.method} ${response.url || requestInfo.url} ` +
        `(${response.status} ${response.statusText}) as JSON`,
    );
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);

    this.status = response.status;
    this.statusText = response.statusText;
    this.headers = response.headers;
    this.response = response;
    this.method = requestInfo.method;
    this.url = response.url || requestInfo.url;
    this.rawBody = rawBody;
    this.cause = cause;
  }
}

async function parseJsonBody(
  response: Response,
  requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
): Promise<unknown> {
  const raw = await response.text();
  const normalized = stripBom(raw);

  if (normalized.trim() === "") {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(normalized);
  } catch (cause) {
    throw new ResponseParseError(response, raw, cause, requestInfo);
  }
}

async function parseErrorBody(response: Response, method: string): Promise<unknown> {
  if (hasNoBody(response, method)) {
    return null;
  }

  const mediaType = getMediaType(response.headers);

  // Fall back to text when blob() is unavailable (e.g. some React Native builds).
  if (mediaType && !isJsonMediaType(mediaType) && !isTextMediaType(mediaType)) {
    return typeof response.blob === "function" ? response.blob() : response.text();
  }

  const raw = await response.text();
  const normalized = stripBom(raw);
  const trimmed = normalized.trim();

  if (trimmed === "") {
    return null;
  }

  if (isJsonMediaType(mediaType) || looksLikeJson(normalized)) {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(normalized);
    } catch {
      return raw;
    }
  }

  return raw;
}

function inferResponseType(response: Response): "json" | "text" | "blob" {
  const mediaType = getMediaType(response.headers);

  if (isJsonMediaType(mediaType)) return "json";
  if (isTextMediaType(mediaType) || mediaType == null) return "text";
  return "blob";
}

async function parseSuccessBody(
  response: Response,
  responseType: "json" | "text" | "blob" | "auto",
  requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
): Promise<unknown> {
  if (hasNoBody(response, requestInfo.method)) {
    return null;
  }

  const effectiveType =
    responseType === "auto" ? inferResponseType(response) : responseType;

  switch (effectiveType) {
    case "json":
      return parseJsonBody(response, requestInfo);

    case "text": {
      const text = await response.text();
      return text === "" ? null : text;
    }

    case "blob":
      if (typeof response.blob !== "function") {
        throw new TypeError(
          "Blob responses are not supported in this runtime. " +
            "Use responseType \"json\" or \"text\" instead.",
        );
      }
      return response.blob();
  }
}

export async function customFetch<T = unknown>(
  input: RequestInfo | URL,
  options: CustomFetchOptions = {},
): Promise<T> {
  input = applyBaseUrl(input);
  const { responseType = "auto", headers: headersInit, ...init } = options;

  const method = resolveMethod(input, init.method);

  if (init.body != null && (method === "GET" || method === "HEAD")) {
    throw new TypeError(`customFetch: ${method} requests cannot have a body.`);
  }

  const headers = mergeHeaders(isRequest(input) ? input.headers : undefined, headersInit);

  if (
    typeof init.body === "string" &&
    !headers.has("content-type") &&
    looksLikeJson(init.body)
  ) {
    headers.set("content-type", "application/json");
  }

  if (responseType === "json" && !headers.has("accept")) {
    headers.set("accept", DEFAULT_JSON_ACCEPT);
  }

  // Attach bearer token when an auth getter is configured and no
  // Authorization header has been explicitly provided.
  if (_authTokenGetter && !headers.has("authorization")) {
    const token = await _authTokenGetter();
    if (token) {
      headers.set("authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
    }
  }

  const requestInfo = { method, url: resolveUrl(input) };

  const response = await fetch(input, { ...init, method, headers });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorData = await parseErrorBody(response, method);
    throw new ApiError(response, errorData, requestInfo);
  }

  return (await parseSuccessBody(response, responseType, requestInfo)) as T;
}

/**
 * Generated by orval v8.23.0 üç∫

import {
  useMutation,
  useQuery
} from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type {
  MutationFunction,
  QueryFunction,
  QueryKey,
  UseMutationOptions,
  UseMutationResult,
  UseQueryOptions,
  UseQueryResult
} from '@tanstack/react-query';

import type {
  Alert,
  BadRequestResponse,
  DashboardSummary,
  FarmZone,
  FinanceSummary,
  Goat,
  GoatInput,
  HealthStatus,

  TaskInput

import type { ErrorType , BodyType } from '../custom-fetch';

type AwaitedInput<T> = PromiseLike<T> | T;

      type Awaited<O> = O extends AwaitedInput<infer T> ? T : never;


type SecondParameter<T extends (...args: never) => unknown> = Parameters<T>[1];



const withQueryKey = <T extends object, K>(query: T, queryKey: K): T & { queryKey: K } => {
  const result = { queryKey } as T & { queryKey: K };
  for (const key of Object.keys(query)) {
    // The explicit queryKey always wins, matching the previous
    // `{ ...query, queryKey }` spread where it was set last.
    if (key === 'queryKey') continue;
    Object.defineProperty(result, key, {
      enumerable: true,
      configurable: true,
      get: () => (query as Record<string, unknown>)[key],
    });
  }
  return result;
};

) => {

const {query: queryOptions, request: requestOptions} = options ?? {};

  const queryKey =  queryOptions?.queryKey ?? getHealthCheckQueryKey();



    const queryFn: QueryFunction<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof healthCheck>>> = ({ signal }) => healthCheck({ signal, ...requestOptions });





   return  { queryKey, queryFn, ...queryOptions} as UseQueryOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof healthCheck>>, TError, TData> & { queryKey: QueryKey }
}

export function useHealthCheck<TData = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof healthCheck>>, TError = ErrorType<unknown>>(
  options?: { query?:UseQueryOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof healthCheck>>, TError, TData>, request?: SecondParameter<typeof customFetch>}

 ):  UseQueryResult<TData, TError> & { queryKey: QueryKey } {

  const queryOptions = getHealthCheckQueryOptions(options)

  const query = useQuery(queryOptions) as  UseQueryResult<TData, TError> & { queryKey: QueryKey };

  return withQueryKey(query, queryOptions.queryKey);
}

export const getListTasksUrl = (params?: ListTasksParams,) => {
  const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams();

  Object.entries(params || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => {

    if (value !== undefined) {
      normalizedParams.append(key, value === null ? 'null' : String(value))
    }
  });

  const stringifiedParams = normalizedParams.toString();

  return stringifiedParams.length > 0 ? `/api/tasks?${stringifiedParams}` : `/api/tasks`
}

/**
 * @summary List farm tasks
 */
export const listTasks = async (params?: ListTasksParams, options?: Parameters<typeof customFetch>[1]): Promise<Task[]> => {

  return customFetch<Task[]>(getListTasksUrl(params),
  {
    ...options,
    method: 'GET'


  }
);}





export const getListTasksQueryKey = (params?: ListTasksParams,) => {
    return [
    `/api/tasks`, ...(params ? [params] : [])
    ] as const;
    }


export const getListTasksQueryOptions = <TData = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listTasks>>, TError = ErrorType<unknown>>(params?: ListTasksParams, options?: { query?:UseQueryOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listTasks>>, TError, TData>, request?: SecondParameter<typeof customFetch>}
) => {

const {query: queryOptions, request: requestOptions} = options ?? {};

  const queryKey =  queryOptions?.queryKey ?? getListTasksQueryKey(params);



    const queryFn: QueryFunction<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listTasks>>> = ({ signal }) => listTasks(params, { signal, ...requestOptions });





   return  { queryKey, queryFn, ...queryOptions} as UseQueryOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listTasks>>, TError, TData> & { queryKey: QueryKey }
}

export type ListTasksQueryResult = NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listTasks>>>
export type ListTasksQueryError = ErrorType<unknown>

export const getCreateTaskUrl = () => {




  return `/api/tasks`
}

/**
 * @summary Create a farm task
 */
export const createTask = async (taskInput: TaskInput, options?: Parameters<typeof customFetch>[1]): Promise<Task> => {

  return customFetch<Task>(getCreateTaskUrl(),
  {
    ...options,
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...options?.headers },
    body: JSON.stringify(taskInput)
  }
);}





export const getCreateTaskMutationOptions = <TError = ErrorType<BadRequestResponse>,
    TContext = unknown>(options?: { mutation?:UseMutationOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createTask>>, TError,{data: BodyType<TaskInput>}, TContext>, request?: SecondParameter<typeof customFetch>}
): UseMutationOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createTask>>, TError,{data: BodyType<TaskInput>}, TContext> => {

const mutationKey = ['createTask'];
const {mutation: mutationOptions, request: requestOptions} = options ?
      options.mutation && 'mutationKey' in options.mutation && options.mutation.mutationKey ?
      options
      : {...options, mutation: {...options.mutation, mutationKey}}
      : {mutation: { mutationKey, }, request: undefined};




      const mutationFn: MutationFunction<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createTask>>, {data: BodyType<TaskInput>}> = (props) => {
          const {data} = props ?? {};

          return  createTask(data,requestOptions)
        }






  return  { mutationFn, ...mutationOptions }}

    export type CreateTaskMutationResult = NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createTask>>>
    export type CreateTaskMutationBody = BodyType<TaskInput>
    export type CreateTaskMutationError = ErrorType<BadRequestResponse>

    /**
 * @summary Create a farm task
 */
export const useCreateTask = <TError = ErrorType<BadRequestResponse>,
    TContext = unknown>(options?: { mutation?:UseMutationOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createTask>>, TError,{data: BodyType<TaskInput>}, TContext>, request?: SecondParameter<typeof customFetch>}
 ): UseMutationResult<
        Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createTask>>,
        TError,
        {data: BodyType<TaskInput>},
        TContext
      > => {
      return useMutation(getCreateTaskMutationOptions(options));
    }

  return `/api/tasks/${taskId}/complete`

 * @summary Mark a task complete

    taskCompletionInput?: TaskCompletionInput, options?: Parameters<typeof customFetch>[1]): Promise<Task> => {

  return customFetch<Task>(getCompleteTaskUrl(taskId),
  {
    ...options,
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...options?.headers },
    body: JSON.stringify(taskCompletionInput)
  }
);}

      : {mutation: { mutationKey, }, request: undefined};




      const mutationFn: MutationFunction<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof completeTask>>, {taskId: number;data?: BodyType<TaskCompletionInput>}> = (props) => {
          const {taskId,data} = props ?? {};

          return  completeTask(taskId,data,requestOptions)
        }






  return  { mutationFn, ...mutationOptions }}

export const getSearchFarmUrl = (params: SearchFarmParams,) => {
  const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams();

  Object.entries(params || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => {

    if (value !== undefined) {
      normalizedParams.append(key, value === null ? 'null' : String(value))
    }
  });

  const stringifiedParams = normalizedParams.toString();

  return stringifiedParams.length > 0 ? `/api/search?${stringifiedParams}` : `/api/search`
}

/**
 * @summary Search farm records across modules
 */
export const searchFarm = async (params: SearchFarmParams, options?: Parameters<typeof customFetch>[1]): Promise<SearchResult[]> => {

  return customFetch<SearchResult[]>(getSearchFarmUrl(params),
  {
    ...options,
    method: 'GET'


  }
);}





export const getSearchFarmQueryKey = (params?: SearchFarmParams,) => {
    return [
    `/api/search`, ...(params ? [params] : [])
    ] as const;
    }


export const getSearchFarmQueryOptions = <TData = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof searchFarm>>, TError = ErrorType<unknown>>(params: SearchFarmParams, options?: { query?:UseQueryOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof searchFarm>>, TError, TData>, request?: SecondParameter<typeof customFetch>}
) => {

const {query: queryOptions, request: requestOptions} = options ?? {};

  const queryKey =  queryOptions?.queryKey ?? getSearchFarmQueryKey(params);



    const queryFn: QueryFunction<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof searchFarm>>> = ({ signal }) => searchFarm(params, { signal, ...requestOptions });





   return  { queryKey, queryFn, ...queryOptions} as UseQueryOptions<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof searchFarm>>, TError, TData> & { queryKey: QueryKey }
}

export type SearchFarmQueryResult = NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof searchFarm>>>
